sosCard.title: SOS — need help?
sosCard.hint: Alerts your family with your location

account.text: Create an account to save your complaints and contacts

sos.title: In danger? Press the red SOS
sos.body: SOS sends your family a message with your location. For the police, call 112.

complaint.title: See a problem? Take a photo, file a complaint
complaint.body: Broken handpump, damaged road or garbage — take a photo and send it. You can follow every step here.

sahayak.title: Ask Sahayak
sahayak.body: Ask about government schemes or get a letter written for the Panchayat. You can speak instead of typing.
